block.heading: OEM Boys' Hawaiian Shirt Quotes, Sample Costs and Payment Terms
paragraphs: Each sample costs USD 50, and the design fee is USD 50 per design, which covers its pattern or print and all of its colourways. Neither fee is refunded or credited against a bulk order. You pay a 50% deposit when you confirm the order and the remaining 50% before shipment.
We've run as a [factory-owned business](/about-us/) since 2011, so production and export stay under our direct control. You agree your order directly with our team, not through shops or marketplaces.

Our [Product Development service](/product-development/) develops OEM and ODM styles from your design, picture or idea. We make CAD patterns and digital grading in-house, so sizing stays consistent on repeat orders.
With our [Sampling service](/sampling/), we check fit against a measurement sheet and offer live fitting videos. If you want samples sent to you by courier, you pay an extra USD 50 for delivery.

Our [quality control](/quality-control/) checks every stage, and independent inspectors such as SGS or BV are welcome. Boys' shirts headed to US stores need mandatory CPSIA lab testing, which we book before shipment so you can issue a [Children's Product Certificate](/kids-hawaiian-clothing-manufacturer/). Tested fabrics and trims carry OEKO-TEX Standard 100, and organic cotton styles carry GOTS. Our cotton sourcing follows BCI, our quality management runs under ISO 9001, and WRAP covers social compliance. Garment tolerances are ±1 cm at chest, length and waist and ±0.5 cm at smaller points. Residual shrinkage stays within 3% in both directions after three home washes. Colourfastness reaches Grade 4 or above for washing and Grade 3–4 or above for rubbing and light.
Our [order process](/our-process/) starts with a quote, and sampling follows once we've agreed the price.

You can choose from [fabric options](/hawaiian-fabrics/) that include cotton, polyester, spandex, nylon, rayon, viscose, modal, Tencel, linen, silk and wool. Blends include 95% cotton 5% spandex, 80% nylon 20% spandex and 65% polyester 35% cotton.
Our English-speaking [contact team](/contact-us/) replies within one business day, and you can reach them by phone or video throughout your order.
With our [Bulk Production service](/bulk-production/), you can mix sizes within the minimum at no extra charge, and we help with size splits and pre-order planning.
Our [Customisation service](/customization/) offers camp, spread and notch collars, each adjusted to your design.
Our [Custom Print Design service](/custom-print-design/) creates tropical floral, foliage, beach-scene and novelty artwork that's unique to your group.
Our [Matching Family & Group Sets service](/matching-family-group-sets/) carries one aloha print from toddler sizes up to 5XL, with the artwork scaled to each garment size.
Our [Embroidery service](/embroidery/) supplies detailed embroidery, patches and labels.

In our [Garment Dyeing service](/garment-dyeing/), we use certified dyestuffs and silicone softeners that meet OEKO-TEX Standard 100 Class I requirements. We confirm certificate coverage before you order and send current copies whenever you ask.
With our [Private Label service](/private-label/), only your brand appears on the approved labels, trims and coordinated retail-ready packaging.
Our [Trims & Accessories service](/trims-accessories/) helps you choose buttons, plackets and colour-matched accessories, including custom hardware.

To [request a quote](/request-a-quote/), send us your specifications, sketches or photos, or the garment type, along with sizes and quantities. We price by style, fabric, quantity, size range and customisation, and we send your quote within 24 hours. Each quote stays valid for 30 days from issue.

Our [Custom Buttons service](/custom-buttons/) needs a separate lot of 1,000 custom-dyed or logo-engraved buttons per design in each colour, and we store the spares for reorders. Colour-matched stock buttons have no separate minimum and work at the 50-piece shirt minimum.

Our [Custom Labels & Hang Tags service](/custom-labels-hang-tags/) writes destination-specific fibre, origin and wash-tested care wording based on the actual materials. We add your RN or CA number where one is needed and send you the artwork to approve before production.
Our [Custom Printing service](/custom-printing/) uses roll printing for continuous all-over repeats and panel printing for motifs that need precise placement.

columns: What it means for your order
rows: Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour, so small and growing labels have a quantity they can start with. We agree first trial runs case by case, and how flexible the quantity can be depends on what production allows.
Our [order process](/our-process/) begins with a quotation. Once you agree to the price, we make your sample.

A standard sample takes 10 to 15 days. Each sample costs USD 50, and the design fee is USD 50 per design, which covers its pattern or print and all colourways. Neither fee is refunded or credited against your bulk order.
On top of the sample fee, you pay USD 50 for [sample courier delivery](/sampling/).

You pay a 50% deposit when you confirm the order. Once your sample is approved and we've received the deposit, bulk production takes 35 to 40 days, depending on order size and season. You pay the remaining 50% before shipment.
We ship on FOB, CIF or DDP terms. [DDP delivery is available worldwide](/shipping/), with duties, customs and freight in one price.

Our [factory and export business](/about-us/) is one company, so quality, cost and delivery stay under our direct control. The factory has been running since 2011, and every B2B order is agreed directly with our team, through this website or our own team, never through an online shop or any third-party marketplace or platform.

Our [OEM and ODM product development](/product-development/) starts from your design, a picture or an idea. Our in-house team handles pattern design, grading and fit development, which cuts down the design back-and-forth.

Our [Quality Control service](/quality-control/) checks incoming fabric, cutting and sewing, runs random checks and a full final inspection, and welcomes independent pre-shipment inspectors such as SGS or BV. Tested fabrics and trims carry OEKO-TEX Standard 100, organic cotton styles carry GOTS, cotton comes through Better Cotton (BCI), and our factory holds ISO 9001 and WRAP. For girls’ sizes 2T to 14, we design cords, ties and straps to EN 14682 for the EU and ASTM F1816 for the US, leave out neck drawstrings and keep tie ends within permitted lengths. On sizes under 3 years, we leave off detachable small trims such as sequins, beads and loose bows. Girls' dresses for the US go through CPSIA lab tests on every order, whose results back your [Children's Product Certificate](/kids-hawaiian-clothing-manufacturer/); 90 N button-pull checks run in our own QC. Before sampling, we wash-test fabric for colour bleed and for shrinkage within 3% in length and width after three home washes. You can check this yourself: measure the sample's chest and body length, wash it three times on its own with a white cloth following the care label (cold or 30°C gentle for rayon, 40°C for cotton), line-dry it, then remeasure and check the cloth for transferred colour.

Our wider [Hawaiian fabrics range](/hawaiian-fabrics/) covers cotton, polyester, spandex, nylon, rayon, viscose, modal, Tencel, linen, silk and wool, including blends such as 80% nylon 20% spandex, alongside the cotton-spandex and polyester-cotton options for these dresses.
When you [contact our team](/contact-us/), we reply within one business day and communicate in English, and we're available by phone or video call at every stage.

With [Matching Family & Group Sets](/matching-family-group-sets/), we carry the same aloha print across sets from toddler sizes up to 5XL, scaling the artwork to each garment size so the print lines up consistently from piece to piece.
For [Cut & Sew](/cut-sew/), we take your supplied DXF patterns through pre-production with two sample rounds, pattern and machine adjustments, and regrading of the full size range.

Our [Garment Dyeing service](/garment-dyeing/) uses certified dyestuffs and silicone softeners that are free from heavy metals, formaldehyde and banned azo compounds and meet OEKO-TEX Standard 100 Class I requirements. We confirm the certificate covering each dye, softener and fabric before you order, and we supply current copies on request so you can check them against your market’s requirements.

If you need a private label kids' Hawaiian dress manufacturer, our [Private Label service](/private-label/) is available on every order. It covers woven main and neck labels, printed labels, heat-transfer care and size labels, hang tags, branded metal tags, logo application and silicone branding, and we make the woven labels and heat-transfer artwork in-house.

For [Custom Buttons](/custom-buttons/), custom-dyed or logo-engraved buttons carry the button maker’s own separate minimum of 1,000 pieces per design in each colour, and we store spares for your reorders. Smaller runs use colour-matched stock buttons with no separate button minimum, including at the 50-piece dress minimum.

Through [Custom Labels & Hang Tags](/custom-labels-hang-tags/), we draft fibre content, care symbols and country of origin from your style’s actual fabrics and trims, and add your RN or CA number where it's needed. We send the artwork for your approval before production and base care instructions on fabric and print wash tests. We follow destination requirements, including US FTC care-labelling and textile rules, EU and UK fibre-name rules and Australian care-labelling standards, and we check labels on every private-label order.

Our [custom printing options](/custom-printing/) include roll screen or digital printing before cutting for rayon, cotton, linen and silk; sublimation, restricted to light-coloured polyester and blends containing at least 60% polyester; placement printing on cut panels; and reverse-print aloha shirts on cotton. Dark grounds: our partner mill dyes the ground for screen printing, or we print it digitally. Screen-print repeats go up to 64 cm, and digital and sublimation repeats go up to the full 150 cm printable width. Large repeats or pattern matching use 10–15% more fabric, and that's included in your unit price.

block.heading: Removable Swim Pads and Secure Tie Finishes
rows: Choose perforated open-cell foam for quick drainage or closed-cell swim foam for very low water uptake. Both are 3 to 5 mm thick, and we check the pad you choose wet during sampling.
Swim-fabric covers keep the pads in shape through repeated wetting and drying, and stitched pockets have cleanly finished openings.
Ties are made from self-fabric tubing, and we seal the ends.

items.question: What bust, waist, hip and finished-length measurements define your adult and girls' dress sizes, and how much wearing ease does each silhouette allow?
items.answer: Dresses keep their own chart, XS to 4XL, covering bust 82–126 cm, waist 64–108 cm and hip 88–132 cm. Girls' sizes go from 2T with a 53 cm chest up to 14 with an 80 cm chest. Finished lengths are about 90 cm for minis, 110–115 cm for midis and 135–145 cm for maxis. Slip and fitted cuts get about 2–4 cm of bust ease, wrap and shirt dresses 6–10 cm, and tiered and kaftan styles 12 cm or more. We can also work to your own size chart.

items.question: Can I take one of your dress silhouettes and change its length, neckline or sleeves, or add pockets or tiers?
items.answer: Yes. We can change the length, neckline, sleeves, fabric or colour, and add pockets, tiers or ruffles. Our in-house team revises the existing pattern, we quote you before sampling, and your new sample is ready in 10 to 15 days.

items.question: Which design choices on a resort dress raise the price most, for example a maxi length, tiers, a full lining or a placement print?
items.answer: Fabric use has the biggest effect on price. Maxis, multiple tiers, ruffles and matched placement or border prints cost more than minis or midis with all-over repeats. Full lining, embroidery and built-in cups add materials and sewing time, and we itemise each option you choose.

items.question: Which of your fabrics suit close-fitting slip dresses, gathered tiered dresses and structured shirt dresses without compromising their intended shape?
items.answer: For close-fitting slips we use fluid silk blends, rayon, chiffon and satin. Light cotton voile and lawn hold the volume of gathered tiers without adding bulk. Cotton poplin, stretch poplin, linen and viscose shirting keep the collars, plackets and bodies of shirt dresses crisp.

items.question: Can you make bias-cut satin or silk-blend slip dresses, and what fabric or design restrictions apply?
items.answer: Yes. We cut polyester, viscose and silk-blend satin at 70–120 GSM on the true bias, one layer at a time, then hang each dress for 24 hours before we level the hem. Bias cutting uses about 20–30% more fabric than straight-grain cutting, and it suits all-over or small-repeat prints, not borders or placements. Fabrics under 60 GSM or with more than 5% spandex don't work for bias cutting.

items.question: Do you offer both adjustable true-wrap dresses and fixed faux-wrap dresses, and which fastening options are available for each?
items.answer: Yes. True wraps fit a wide size range, with an adjustable self-tie that passes through a side-seam opening and an internal snap or hook-and-eye at the inner crossover. Faux wraps have a fixed neckline and are sewn closed at the waist. They pull on or use a side zip, and you can add a hidden press stud at the bust overlap.

items.question: Can you incorporate sewn-in cups or an internal support layer into backless and low-neckline resort dresses, and what support constructions fall outside your capability?
items.answer: Yes. We offer fixed or removable moulded cups, hidden power-mesh support, clear stabilising tape at the neckline, bodice lining and light spiral boning, and we pick what suits your design. We don't make fully corseted bodices, underwired cups or structured bra frames, so a dress that needs that level of support has to be worn with a separate strapless bra.

items.question: Can you combine a knitted bodice with a woven skirt or add mesh and lace panels, and what material combinations are outside your production capabilities?
items.answer: Yes. We join knitted bodices to woven skirts with stretch stay tape at the waist. We also add mesh overlays, sleeves, cut-out fills, ruching or illusion panels, as well as lace trims and inserts. We don't combine fabrics with conflicting care needs, such as dry-clean-only silk or wool with washable knits, and we don't work with leather, sequinned panels or bonded seams.

block.heading: Private Label Uniform Shirts With Your Prints and Logos
paragraphs: Your logo stays readable only when it contrasts with what's directly around it, and dense, multicoloured prints take that contrast away faster than thread colour can bring it back.

items.heading: Logos against tropical prints
paragraphs: On dense prints, go for solid patches, sublimated 10 x 10 cm plain zones on the chest or back, or contrast-thread chest embroidery. Pantone-matched logos on calmer patterns lose readability at a distance.

items.heading: Design and print development
paragraphs: [Product Development](/product-development/) starts your OEM/ODM styles from a design, a picture or an idea, and [Custom Print Design](/custom-print-design/) gives you 3 mock-ups within 48 hours.

items.heading: Coordinated team sizing
paragraphs: With [Matching Family & Group Sets](/matching-family-group-sets/), we coordinate Pantone-matched shirts, size labels and multiple destinations. Our [aloha shirt sizing](/) runs from adult XXS to 5XL, plus youth, children and seniors.

items.heading: Patterns and fine seams
paragraphs: Our [Cut & Sew](/cut-sew/) service keeps your patterns on file (releasing one costs USD 580) and tests 1 cm overlocked or French seams on lightweight rayon to ISO 13936-2.

items.heading: Schools and youth
paragraphs: We carry your school logo and colours across boardshorts for both children and adults, and both go into one combined order.

items.heading: Clubs and events
paragraphs: We make custom swim shorts for swimming clubs, water polo teams, beach volleyball teams and open-water events.

items.heading: Printing limits and allowances
paragraphs: [Custom Printing](/custom-printing/) gives you up to 12 colours. Screen repeats go up to 64 cm, digital and sublimation repeats up to 150 cm, and extra fabric for large repeats is already in your price.

items.heading: Your brand, direct ordering
paragraphs: Our [factory-owned business](/about-us/) has been running since 2011, and you agree orders directly with us. With [Private Label](/private-label/), only your brand appears on labels, trims and packaging.

items.heading: Buttons and repeat production
paragraphs: [Custom Buttons](/custom-buttons/) tooling is quoted separately, and we keep the moulds for 3 years. [Bulk Production](/bulk-production/) remakes approved styles from archived specifications.

items.heading: Distribution to your destinations
paragraphs: For one order split across staff or branch addresses, our [aloha work uniform programmes](/aloha-work-uniform-manufacturer/) set out how we ship to each.

items.heading: Shipping routes
paragraphs: Our [Shipping service](/shipping/) delivers to the United States, Hawaii, Canada, Australia, the Caribbean, the UK and Europe by express, air, sea or door-to-door, depending on your order size and timeline.

items.heading: English-speaking support
paragraphs: You can [contact our English-speaking team](/contact-us/) by phone or video call at any point in your order, and we reply to every enquiry within one business day.

block.heading: Embroidery Techniques, Fabrics and Placement Options
paragraphs: Dense fills stiffen a lightweight shirt. Appliqué keeps the drape because the fabric is secured only at its edges. We cut and adhere your pattern and add cotton padding to give it a raised effect.

items.heading: Fabric and technique
paragraphs: We embroider directly onto cotton, rayon from about 100 gsm, linen and blends with up to 5% spandex, using cut-away backing. Silk and fabrics under 100 gsm need embroidered patches so they don't pucker.

items.heading: Placement and alignment
paragraphs: We embroider the flat panels before the shirt is assembled, so your design can go on the chest, pocket, back, sleeve, collar points or front hem. A design that crosses the pocket lines up within 3 mm, and collar stitching stays clear of the roll line. A design that crosses the opening splits at the placket edge, clear of the buttonholes.

items.heading: Your manufacturing partner
paragraphs: Our [company](/about-us/) has run its own factory since 2011 and handles production and export directly for business buyers worldwide. You agree your order with our team, not through an online shop or marketplace.

items.heading: Developing your shirt
paragraphs: Our [Product Development service](/product-development/) supports OEM and ODM work. You can bring your own custom designs, choose ready designs graded to international sizes, or combine the two. We do pattern, grading and fit work in-house, and you don't need a tech pack to start.

items.heading: Wider fabric choices
paragraphs: Our [fabric range](/hawaiian-fabrics/) covers cotton, polyester, spandex, nylon, rayon, viscose, modal, Tencel, linen, silk and wool. It also includes blends such as 95% cotton 5% spandex, 80% nylon 20% spandex and 65% polyester 35% cotton.

items.heading: One coordinated process
paragraphs: Our [production process](/our-process/) keeps fabric, embroidery, printing, sewing and finishing on one timeline with one contact. We agree your quote before sampling, and you approve the sample before bulk production starts.

items.heading: Direct English-speaking contact
paragraphs: You can [contact our English-speaking team](/contact-us/) by phone or video call at any point in your order. We reply to every enquiry within one business day.

items.heading: Individual uniform details
paragraphs: Our [Hawaiian uniform shirts](/hawaiian-uniform-shirt-manufacturer/) pair shared prints and branding with individual names, titles, initials or numbers. We add these in embroidery or heat-transfer vinyl from your spreadsheet. This adds 3 to 5 production days, and then we pack by department, branch or name list.

block.heading: Blind Shipping and Split Deliveries for Aloha Shirts

items.heading: Blind shipping
paragraphs: We ship shirts for your business to your warehouses, boutiques, resort shops or your own customers' addresses in neutral parcel packaging with no factory branding.

items.heading: Split deliveries
paragraphs: With multi-destination DDP, we split a single bulk order across several destinations, including sending 500 shirts to 500 staff or store addresses for one business order.

items.heading: Address preparation
paragraphs: For blind-shipped and split orders, you send us the complete address list in one consistent spreadsheet before packing starts.

block.heading: OEM Dress Quotes, Development and Sample Approval
paragraphs: Each sample costs USD 50, and design costs USD 50 per pattern or print, covering all colourways. Neither fee is refunded or credited against bulk.

steps.heading: Request your quote
steps.text: Send references, specifications or garment types with sizes and quantities, and we send your [quote](/request-a-quote/) within 24 hours. It is valid for 30 days.

steps.heading: Work directly with us
steps.text: Our [factory-owning company](/about-us/) has operated since 2011, and every B2B order is agreed with our team, not through an online shop or marketplace.

steps.heading: Develop your dress
steps.text: Our [Product Development service](/product-development/) works from your OEM specifications or ODM ideas and does pattern design, grading and fit development in-house.

steps.heading: Approve your sample
steps.text: Through our [Sampling service](/sampling/), we refine the fit until you approve, which fixes fit, construction and branding for bulk. Sample courier delivery costs USD 50.

steps.heading: Schedule your launch
steps.text: [Launch planning](/our-process/) needs your approval and deposit at least 90 days before the goods reach your warehouse, so stock for May means approving in mid-January.

steps.heading: Build your collection
steps.text: Our [Bulk Production service](/bulk-production/) supports print tests and boutique drops, including a 5-print collection totalling 250 units instead of a single SKU of 1,500 or more.

steps.heading: Bulk manufacturing
steps.text: Cutting, stitching and finishing your dresses takes 35 to 40 days. Order size and season set the production schedule.

steps.heading: Final inspection
steps.text: We give your finished order a full final inspection before it ships.

steps.heading: Shipping terms
steps.text: We ship on FOB, CIF or DDP terms. [DDP delivery is available worldwide](/shipping/), with duties, customs and freight in one price.

block.heading: After-delivery quality support.

steps.text: Let us know about a quality problem within 7 days and send photos or videos showing it.

steps.heading: Receive a solution

steps.heading: Resolve the issue
steps.text: Solutions can include a repair, remake, replacement, discount or credit. Any item confirmed as defective is remade at no cost to you.

block.heading: Order Minimums and Production Schedules
paragraphs: You can order from 50 pieces per style in each colour, which gives small and growing labels a way in. We agree first-trial quantities with you case by case, and production requirements set how far we can flex. Your order then goes through the development, approval and delivery steps below.

With our [Product Development service](/product-development/), our in-house design team works with you on fit, pattern, grading, print, fabric and trim development. That applies whether you bring an OEM design or need us to develop an ODM collection from your requirements and brand positioning.

Our [factory and export business](/about-us/) has been running since 2011. We work directly with business buyers worldwide, not through online shops or marketplaces, and we produce for more than 350 independent labels. Before you order, we can show you case examples where we have permission, but we never disclose unreleased designs covered by an NDA.

For [fabric options](/hawaiian-fabrics/), you can choose cotton, polyester, spandex, nylon, rayon, viscose, modal, Tencel, linen, silk or wool. Blends include 95% cotton 5% spandex, 80% nylon 20% spandex and 65% polyester 35% cotton.
Our [Customisation service](/customization/) puts your company logo on the shirts and matches your brand colours to Pantone references.
Our [Embroidery service](/embroidery/) covers intricate embroidery prepared by a designer, plus patches and labels. Embroidered logos stand up to repeated washing and hard wear without fraying.
Our [Garment Dyeing service](/garment-dyeing/) includes Pantone matching at no extra charge, plus one round of lab dips for you to approve before bulk production.

Under our [Custom Print Design service](/custom-print-design/), unchanged base shirts and library prints stay non-exclusive. A new or adapted print, meaning one recoloured, rescaled or reworked from a library design or developed from your artwork, becomes exclusive to your label under NDA once you pay its design fee. The unchanged original stays in our library.

block.heading: Ways to Source Trims & Start Your Order
paragraphs: Here's how you can work with us on trims and get your order under way.

items.heading: Start from 50 pieces
paragraphs: Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour, so small and growing labels can order with us. We agree your first trial run case by case, as flexibly as production allows.

items.heading: One owned factory since 2011
paragraphs: Production and export sit within [one company that owns its factory](/about-us/), running since 2011, so we keep quality, cost and delivery under our direct control.

items.heading: OEM or ODM development
paragraphs: Through our [Product Development](/product-development/) service, a new style can start from your own design, a picture or just an idea. We start work and quote without a tech pack.

items.heading: Quote before sample
paragraphs: We [quote first and agree the timeline with you](/our-process/) before production. Timing also depends on fabric availability, how ready your artwork is, the trims and the shipping method.

items.heading: Combined decoration
paragraphs: We combine embroidery on the same shirt with a screen-printed back graphic, an all-over sublimation print or heat-transfer elements.

items.heading: Stitching over prints
paragraphs: We embroider straight over screen, digital or sublimation prints. For example, we outline a printed hibiscus or add texture to your printed logo.

block.heading: Which Fabric and Print Method Fit Your Design and Budget?
paragraphs: Your fabric, ground colour and repeat size decide which print method works.
columns: What we supply and how we produce it
rows: Our [Hawaiian Fabrics service](/hawaiian-fabrics/) offers cotton, polyester, spandex, nylon, rayon, viscose, modal, Tencel, linen, silk and wool, including 95% cotton 5% spandex, 80% nylon 20% spandex and 65% polyester 35% cotton blends, as finished shirts or as fabric by the metre or roll. Library and custom fabric prints start at 300 metres per colourway, in rolls of about 50 to 100 metres. We inspect each roll for shade, defects and width, then pack it on a core in sealed film for export.

Sublimation handles repeats across the full 150 cm printable width and up to 150 cm long. We plan matching at the marker stage and cut each panel from its matching point on the printed roll instead of nesting panels freely. That extra fabric gets you unbroken matching across the collar, front placket, pocket and hem.

Our [Custom Printing service](/custom-printing/) prints rayon, cotton, linen and silk on the roll by screen or digital printing before cutting for all-over patterns. Sublimation is limited to light-coloured polyester and blends with at least 60% polyester. Engineered or placement designs are printed on cut panels before sewing, so the motifs land in the same position on every shirt. We make reverse prints on cotton. For dark grounds, we either dye the fabric before screen printing or print the full ground digitally. Screen repeats go up to 64 cm and digital repeats up to 150 cm wide. Large repeats or pattern matching need 10–15% extra fabric, which is built into your unit price. We don't change the approved sample's method, fabric base or colour reference unless you approve it in writing. Colour stays within ΔE ≤ 2.0 and placement within 0.5 cm. Send 300 DPI PNG, JPG, JPEG, PSD, PDF, AI or EPS artwork or a reference sample. Vector EPS or AI with outlined text and expanded strokes is best, or else high-quality JPG or PDF. We check files for clarity, durability and compliance, and you confirm the layout before production.

Alongside screen printing, our [Embroidery service](/embroidery/) offers intricate custom work, patches and labels made by skilled fashion designers. Our embroidered logos hold up to repeated washing and hard wear without fraying.

paragraphs: If any detail is too small, we flag it on your proof and suggest thicker artwork before production.
